observations: Three photos show a large blue industrial gear reducer mounted on a blue flange base.
The reducer has a yellow output shaft with a flange and a flange bolted to the side.
The body is cast metal with visible bolts and a circular flange on one end.
The reducer is placed on a brick and concrete surface, likely outdoors or in a workshop.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the body or flange in any photo.
The watermark 'IFABROS INDUSTRIAL POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.
The yellow shaft appears to be a standard industrial gear shaft, possibly with a flange for coupling.

claims.claim: Gear reducer 15 to 20hp cast bodies types
claims.evidence: No horsepower rating or model number is visible in any photo. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images alone.

risks.risk: The reducer may not be 15-20hp as claimed, or may be a different model or size.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the nameplate or label on the reducer showing the horsepower rating and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic cast gear reducer without horsepower specification, which may be lower than claimed.

risks.risk: The reducer may be damaged or worn, especially on internal gears or bearings, which are not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the internal gears and bearings being rotated or a close-up of the shaft end for wear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or requiring repair, reducing value.

risks.risk: The reducer may not be compatible with the buyer's equipment without additional components (e.g., coupling, mounting flange).
risks.proof: A photo showing the coupling flange and mounting bolt pattern, or a diagram of the reducer's interface.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring additional parts, increasing cost.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate on the gear housing showing the horsepower and model number.
A clear photo of the nameplate or label showing the horsepower and model number.
A video or photo showing the internal gears and bearings being rotated.
A photo of the coupling flange and mounting bolt pattern.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
